name: Snack Pack Vanilla Pudding Cup
whyItWorks: Silky smooth, completely non-abrasive comfort food. Snack Pack vanilla pudding requires zero chewing, provides quick sugar calories, and contains 0g fiber. It coats the esophagus and stomach comfortably.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Peel foil lid and eat with a spoon. Contains nonfat milk—take a lactase enzyme tablet if you have primary lactase deficiency.
watchOuts: Contains nonfat milk; individuals with severe lactose intolerance should take a lactase enzyme tablet.
